# UltraLife Protocol

The bar for participation is: can you talk?

Canonical contracts: https://github.com/ryanultralife/ultralife-protocol
Live node (WASM + agent gateway): https://github.com/ryanultralife/ultralife-node

## Reach
GET  /llms.txt
GET  /.well-known/agent-card.json
GET  /.well-known/did.json
POST /api/protocol   {"op":"tools/call","name":"<tool>","arguments":{}}
POST /api/mcp        JSON-RPC initialize | tools/list | tools/call | resources/list | resources/read

This git repo: clone it, read AGENTS.md, then docs/LLM_AGENT_GUIDE.md.
Optional header on a live node: X-UltraLife-Session

## Rules
- Never put PII, citizenship files, license PDFs, or a diagnosis in a public datum.
- Never Produce or Transfer a restricted lot without a live ControlAttest. Never strip dest_policy.
- A pool ticker is not a bioregion. Parameters are not a DRep vote. Midnight is not a dependency.
- The $20M raise is SPV cash + WorkTickets. Unallocated ULTRA is not that raise.
- Mechanical Battery prime work settles in ULTRA to their bucket.
- ADA is the L1 royalty. fee_pool under its floor halts new L1 mints.
- Clarity is not a license. The SEC Innovation Exemption is not this product.
- The agent builds unsigned transactions. The wallet signs. Validators enforce.
- pNFT is the DID (did:ultralife:<id>). One human, one identity.
- Users, jobs, listings, and pools transact in ULTRA. Do not ask humans for ADA.
- Bioregion pools verify UltraLife (WASM core, Gerolamo, or Hydra) and are paid in ULTRA.
- eUTxO is one-shot: each identity, listing, job, and pool is its own UTxO. Do not batch.
- Genesis UTxO is reference-only. Scripts are genesis-parameterized. Upgrade = none.
- Sequence: boot_node → create_wallet → mint_pnft → then market / jobs / pools.

## Tools
inspect_state, inspect_genesis, inspect_validators, inspect_pools, prove_seal, resolve_did
boot_node, create_wallet, mint_pnft
list_offering, buy_offering, list_job, bid_job
register_pool, delegate_ultra, claim_pool_rewards, open_hydra, pool_verify
claim_ubi, record_impact, register_land

## Examples
{"op":"tools/call","name":"mint_pnft","arguments":{"bioregion":"sierra-nevada"}}
{"op":"tools/call","name":"list_job","arguments":{"title":"Timber frame","bidUltra":80}}
{"op":"tools/call","name":"bid_job","arguments":{"query":"watershed","bidUltra":200}}
{"op":"tools/call","name":"delegate_ultra","arguments":{"pool":"SNEV","amount":10}}
{"op":"tools/call","name":"open_hydra","arguments":{}}
{"op":"tools/call","name":"pool_verify","arguments":{}}

First token: medical isotope lots. presale_isotope, convert_isotope, transfer_isotope, administer_dose, inspect_isotopes
Plant spine: post_record, reveal_record, post_merkle_root, attest_control, presale_grant, presale_offtake, close_ticket, inspect_tickets
Washington direction (draft only, do not send): docs/WASHINGTON_DIRECTION.md
